All our astrologers

Every astrologer on Astrowani is reviewed before they can take consultations — browse all of them, or filter by what you need help with.

Choosing an astrologer on Astrowani

The directory above lists every astrologer currently on the platform. Each profile carries the same information, so the comparison is like for like: specialities, years of experience, the languages they consult in, the per-minute rate they set, and whether they are free to talk right now.

What verified means here

An astrologer cannot take consultations on Astrowani until their application has been reviewed and approved by our team, and a new sign-up stays invisible to customers until that review is finished. What we check is who they are and the background they claim. We do not vouch for any particular reading, and no astrologer on the platform should present one as a guaranteed outcome.

Read the speciality, not just the rating

Speciality is the most useful filter on this page. Someone who works mainly on Vedic birth charts, someone who reads tarot and someone who assesses Vastu for homes are answering different kinds of question, and the strongest reader for one is not automatically the right choice for another. Narrow by the subject you actually want to discuss, then read the individual profiles.

Language matters more than people expect

A consultation is a conversation, and a chart explained in your own first language is far easier to question. Profiles list the languages each astrologer consults in, so pick someone you can interrupt comfortably rather than someone you will politely listen to.

Rates and availability change through the day

Each astrologer sets their own per-minute rate, so rates differ across the directory. The status on a card is live: an astrologer already in a consultation shows as busy and cannot take another until it ends. If the person you want is busy, their profile is still worth opening — you can read their full details and come back.

How do I know which astrologer is right for my question?

Start from the subject rather than the person. For a birth chart, look for Vedic astrology; for a marriage question, kundli matching; for a decision about work, career astrology. Filter by that speciality first, then compare experience, language and rate between the few who come up.

Why is the rate different for each astrologer?

Each astrologer sets their own per-minute rate, and it reflects their own experience and demand rather than a tier we assign them. A higher rate is not a claim of a better reading. You are billed only for the minutes you actually spend talking, and you can end a session from your side at any time.

Can I talk to the same astrologer again?

Yes. Search for them by name or save them as a favourite in the app. Your earlier conversations stay in your history, so they have the context from last time without you having to repeat it.

What if nobody I want is available right now?

Availability changes through the day and a busy astrologer is usually free again shortly. You can also browse by service — kundli reading, kundli matching, tarot reading, numerology, career astrology or Vastu — to find someone else working in the same area.
